question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Shopping**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

__
 
• The blank requires a noun that makes sense in the given context.
 
• The word Shopping fits the context of the sentence.
 
• **Shopping **refers to the activity of buying goods or services from retailers. (खुदरा विक्रेताओं से सामान या सेवाएँ खरीदने की गतिविधि)
 
• It involves selecting and purchasing items based on personal needs, preferences, or desires. ** **
 
 
• **Example**: *She enjoyed shopping for new clothes at the mall over the weekend.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cloths**: Misspelled word for "clothes", which means garments or clothing items. (वस्त्र या कपड़े की वस्तुएँ)
 
• **Sugar**: A sweet substance used in cooking and baking. (खाना पकाने और पकाने में उपयोग किया जाने वाला एक मीठा पदार्थ)
 
• **Jewellery**: Decorative items worn as accessories, typically made of precious metals and gems. (सामान के रूप में पहनी जाने वाली सजावटी वस्तुएँ, आमतौर पर कीमती धातुओं और रत्नों से बनी होती हैं)
